decisions.decision: Elected the FY 2013 officers: Chair Brent Benson, Treasurer Jim Ryan, Secretary Caroline Griffis. The group thanked Robin Corbett and Mary Ann Sudolnick for their prior service.
decisions.quote: elections were held for all of the council positions.

decisions.decision: Funds will be granted for events that take place in Lunenburg and for the Fitchburg Art Museum.
decisions.quote: the group discussed and agreed that funds would be granted for events that take place in lunenburg and for the fitchburg art museum.

decisions.decision: Applications accepted and grants made in the amounts listed (total $4197.00).
The denial letter will be revised to state a preference for activities in Lunenburg with a local sponsor.
decisions.quote: the denial letter will be revised to state that we prefer activities that will take place in lunenburg and have a local sponsor.

decisions.decision: Accepted and denied letters to be ready on the system for the December meeting to streamline the process.
decisions.quote: have the accepted and denied letters ready for the december meeting on the system to streamline the process.

decisions.decision: The Lunenburg Ledger will be used to solicit new members, publicize events and inform the public about the mission.
decisions.quote: the lunenburg ledger is a good communication tool and will be used to solicit new members, events and inform the public about our mission.

decisions.decision: Brent Benson will assemble a schedule of FY 2013 events and notify Council members so they can attend some.
decisions.quote: brent will get a schedule of events together for fy 2013 and notify council members so we can attend some of the events.

decisions.decision: The yearly meeting will be held on the second Wednesday of December, adjusted as needed each year; next year's meeting is December 11, 2013 at 7 PM.
decisions.quote: the group agreed to schedule the yearly meeting on the second wednesday of december but make adjustments as needed each year.
